next_authority.question: Given replicated placement sensitivity but a state-count plateau through R16 on fresh high-resolution B14 dynamic-head evidence, which physically distinct inter-layer closure families remain scientifically admissible after C4K-C4O, and what prospective discriminator is needed before implementing one?

scientific_interpretation: The fresh N01-N04 Reference hierarchy is numerically qualified for the preregistered comparator interpretation: R2048 T8-to-T16 error is componentwise no worse than both R512-to-R2048 and R1024-to-R2048 differences on groundwater and profile views.

No reduced lower-zone member R3-R12 crosses even the R512 comparator-relative groundwater frontier, and none crosses the R1024 or finest-grid temporal-floor frontier. The failure is therefore not an artifact of an underqualified Reference temporal route.

Vertical placement remains a replicated structural result. R4 is componentwise no worse than U4 and R8 no worse than U8 on the groundwater view. U4 is substantially worse, with 224 bottom-flux sign mismatches and one full reversal-sequence mismatch.

Within the lower-zone-focused CURRENT_LAYER_FACE family, increasing state dimension beyond R4/R5 produces essentially no groundwater-response improvement. R5, R6, R8, R12 and R16 have nearly identical storage, cumulative exchange and bottom-flux errors against R2048.

Even R16, which retains 16 layer states at 10-cm spacing, remains far outside both high-resolution spatial comparator envelopes. This makes ordinary state count an implausible primary remedy inside the existing closure family.

C5N therefore separates topology from propagation: placement contains real hydrological information, but the current inter-layer propagation/closure does not transmit that information with high-resolution prescribed-head fidelity.

The next scientific task is not to fit new layer boundaries. It is to reconcile prior closure evidence and identify a genuinely different physically derived inter-layer closure family. C4O remains authoritative that more scalar tuning of the existing fixed-partition closure is not allowed.
